remarks: Pride of ownership in this well-maintained brick Ranch home in the Maryvale School District.  1322sf with 3 bedrooms/ 1 full bath and a 1/2 bath in the basement, and a 2 Car Tandem detached garage.  The fully fenced back yard is has been professionally landscaped (2022) providing low maintenance with a covered patio, hot tub and above ground pool with new sand filter (2024). This home is truly move in ready with many updates: 30 year architectural roof (2018), hot water tank (2018), furnace-A/C, permanent generator, humidifier (2013), windows (2015) Hot tub updates (2021), new sewer line to the street (2022) full bathroom update (2022), and more! The front door entry has a coat closet and the living room boasts beautiful hardwood floors and a bay window.  The fully applianced kitchen has a separate dining area in addition to the breakfast bar.  All 3 bedrooms have spacious closets and original hardwood floors. The bathroom is stunning and was completely redone in 2022 with a tiled tub/shower, new vanity and tiled flooring. The basement is huge and partially finished with a corner craft area including cabinets and countertops.  There is a 1/2 bath and a separate laundry area with washer and dryer (which are included) and plenty of private storage space. This home has so much to offer inside and out in one of the most sought after locations...walking distance to Wegmans...easy access to the NYS Thruway and the 33 expressway to downtown.  Great house..great location!  MOVE IN READY!!
